facility.name: Ec Learning Academy, INC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1106 GREENS PKWY, HOUSTON, TX, 77067

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were 20 children, ages 18 months to 10 years old, with one caregiver. The specified age group was 2 years old; therefore, one caregiver can care for 11 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to report the number of employees that left employment in 2025 by the required date of 1/15/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one lacked documentation of  how they meet the education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80%: Five caregivers did not receive six clock hours of training in person for their respective training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80% (26 TAC §746.1309(g))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80%: The director did not receive six clock hours of training in person for the November 2024-November 2025 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80% (26 TAC §746.1311(j))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 2 lacked a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers on both vans have not been serviced since July 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Kept Sanitary: An instant ice pack explodedd in the First Aid Kit for one van; therefore, it is no longer sanirtary. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Kept Sanitary (26 TAC §746.4001(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: The electronic safety alarms in both vans are not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of 2 years old were observed having screen time,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: One 3 month old child in the infant room was placed on stomach for sleep without doctors safe sleep exception form on file. This is corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies in the dining area were left on a counter where children could reach. This was corrected at inspection and the cleaning supplies were placed were children do not have access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: One outlet cover was missing in the 18 month room and one was missing in the one in the 2 year old room. This was corrected at inspection and covers were place in the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Multiple Occupancy Swings: In the outdoor play area there was a teeter toter for the children to play with. A teeter totter is prohibited. This was corrected at inspection and the teeter totter was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §746.4603(5))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Of the 10 children's recods evaluated five lacked the name and address of the doctor who examined the child within the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: The foreign education document for one staff has not been translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1045)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A solution  of bleach/water is being used as a disinfectant without the other required steps of soapy water and clear water to rinse being done.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The written feeding instructions for one infants have not been updated within the last 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: The infant's bottles were only labeled with the child's first name. The bottles should be labeled with the child's first name and initial of the last name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children were watching a cartoon that was not educational or related to planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One caregiver has not completed an in-person CPR class which allows for practice with a manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A solution  of bleach/water is being used as a disinfectant without the other required steps of soapy water and clear water to rinse being done. This was corrected at inspection when Lysol spray and Clorox wipes were placed in the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat in the infant and 2 year old classroom has tears in it; therefore, it is no longer non-absorbent. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications: Training certificates do not include the trainers qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Childsren are not washing their hands with runnig water and soap before eating breakfast.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered: Staff who administer medication to children are not documented their full name-first and last name. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver did not know the number of children she was responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children: Children are not given alternate activities if they awake before nap timeis over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited. Please provide verification of compliance by 2/17/23.    The operational policies is missing the following information:  1. Procedures for parental notification  2. Procedures for handling medical emergencies  3. Safe sleep policy for infants 12 months old and younger  4. Hearing and vision screening requirements  5. Procedures for parents to review and discuss concerns/questions with the director  6. Procedures for parents to participate in the center's activities  7. Inform parents mothers have a comfortable pace to breastfeed and that breastmilk can be provided  8. Inform parents of the annual training requirements for abuse and neglect; procedures to increase staff and parent awareness regrading abuse and neglect; procedures to increase staff and parent awareness for prevention techniques; community organizations and actions a parent of a child who is a victim should take to obtain assistance  9. Staff vaccination policy  10. Inform parents they may visit the center at any time   11. Inform parent the center is in a gang free zone  12. Inform parents of the requirement for outdoor play and physical activity; The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play [Medium]; the duration of physical activity at  both indoor and outdoor the type of physical activity  children may engage in; each setting in which your physical activity program will take place; the recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and a plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited. Please provide verification of compliance by 2/17/23.    The emergency preparedness plan was reviewed and the following information is missing:  1. How children under the age of 2 will be evacuated  2. How parent/emergency contact information will be evacuated  3. How emergency medical information will be evacuated  4. How the children will be cared for during the emergency  5. How children will be reunited with their parents  6. Staff responsibility in emergencies  7. Who is responsible for calling emergency authorities and Child Care Regulation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, three lacked a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infants were observed sleeping in swings. The caregiver said the children had been sleep for 20 minutes. Children may not sleep in restrictive devices. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Of the 10 personnel files evaluated, two have not completed the required 24 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The length of fire drill is not being documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not receive training in understanding building and physical premises safety for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Of the 10 personnel records evaluatted, two did not have training in First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles and cups are not labeled with initial of the child's last name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, two are behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The emergency preparedness plan was reviewed and the following information is missing:  1. How children under the age of 2 will be evacuated  2. How parent/emergency contact information will be evacuated  3. How emergency medical information will be evacuated  4. How the children will be cared for during the emergency  5. How children will be reunited with their parents  6. Staff responsibility in emergencies  7. Who is responsible for calling emergency authorities and Child Care Regulation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the 10 children's records evaluated; the following information was missing:  1. Six children's records lacked the address and/or phone number for the emergency contact  2. One lacked the name and phone number of a person allowed to pick up the child  3. One lacked the name, address and phone number for the child's doctor or emergency facility
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food: The amount of food the child eats is not being listed on the daily report sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food (26 TAC §746.2431(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director did not receive training in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome, Abusive Head Trauma and Understanding Early Childhood Brain Development for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Of  the 10 personnel records evaluated, two did not complete a training in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome, Abusive Head Trauma and Understanding Early Childhood Brain Development for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

Copy of drivers' licenses for van drivers  6. Documentation of how the caregiver meets the education requirements  7. Documentation that an orientation was completed

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: Caregiver was observed wiping a child's nose and did not wash hands afterwards. This was corrected at inspection after I discussed with caregiver the appropriate times to wash hands. The caregiver was observed washing her hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use: Hand sanitizer was observed accessible to children in three classrooms observed during walkthrough of operation. The hand sanitizer was  removed and stored in a cabinet unaccessible to children during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use (26 TAC §746.3420(5))
